subject: Site Engineer, Site Administration (Newcastle): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello TNT Plumbing team,

I am applying for the Site Engineer (Site Administration) role in Newcastle, advertised on SEEK (job 95220901).

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project in charge engineer and then a field engineer. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

On those sites I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, tracked procurement and materials, reviewed drawings and checked work against them, which lines up with the registers, ITPs, site diaries and delivery tracking in your advert. I have not worked with Tier 1 builders or on plumbing and drainage packages yet, and I have not used Procore or HammerTech.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Site Engineer (Site Administration), Newcastle (SEEK 95220901)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Site Engineer (Site Administration) role with TNT Plumbing & Drainage in Newcastle, advertised on SEEK as job 95220901. The role keeps site documentation, RFIs, ITPs, compliance records and handover documents current for plumbing and drainage packages with Tier 1 builders.

From April to September 2019 I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewing drawings and carrying out site inspections and quality checks. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, preparing site reports, material records and progress reports and working with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. The course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi (2014 to 2019).

I have not worked with Tier 1 builders or on commercial plumbing and drainage work, and I have not used HammerTech, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud or Project Simpel. Your company has delivered work such as the Sydney Water Galston Gorge sewer upgrade, and I would like to learn your documentation systems on the job.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation for the right role. My resume is attached and study drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
